problem_statement: codebayu/template-portfolio is a Vite + React + TypeScript + Tailwind single-page portfolio (react-router-dom routes for Home, About, Skills, Experience, Education, Portfolio, and Contact; framer-motion transitions; @tabler icons). The Portfolio route carries an interactive Project Path Selector: a horizontal segment strip that lets a visitor filter the case studies by delivery stage (All Work / Discovery / Prototype / Build / Launch), driving both the selected-project summary panel and the visible project cards. The interaction works on desktop and tablet, but on a 390px phone the selector strip is the wrong shape: its row is pinned to a single non-wrapping line at a fixed width much wider than the screen, so the five stage segments push the whole document sideways and the Portfolio page scrolls horizontally on mobile. Repair the Project Path Selector flow so the segment strip stays fully usable and stops overflowing on mobile: the segments must reflow within the viewport (for example by wrapping the row and letting each segment size to the available width) so the mobile Portfolio page has no horizontal overflow, while desktop and tablet keep the segments on a comfortable single row. The fix is a layout/CSS change to the selector strip only. Keep the interaction behavior, the segment labels and counts, the selected-project panel, the project cards, the routing, and the rest of the site identical; do not remove segments, hide overflow by clipping the strip, or otherwise change the component's markup, content, or filter logic.
required_content: The Project Path Selector segment strip renders all five stage segments (All Work, Discovery, Prototype, Build, Launch) with their counts on the Portfolio route across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
On a 390px mobile viewport the Portfolio route has no horizontal overflow: the selector segments reflow within the viewport instead of forcing the document wider than the screen.
Desktop and tablet keep the selector segments on a single comfortable row without regressing the existing layout.
The selector remains interactive: choosing a stage still updates the selected-project summary panel and the filtered project cards.
The rest of the portfolio (home hero, navigation, project cards, selected-project panel, footer) stays visually and behaviorally unchanged across all captured states.
design_constraints: Preserve the dark teal-accented portfolio design language: rounded segment chips, teal active state, count badges, Tailwind spacing rhythm, and the surrounding Portfolio grid.
Fix the overflow by making the segment row responsive (wrap and/or flexible segment widths), not by clipping the strip with overflow-x:hidden or by deleting segments.
Do not change the Project Path Selector markup, labels, counts, filter logic, or any other route; the change is confined to the selector strip's layout styling.
The mobile Portfolio page, the selector strip, the selected-project panel, and the project cards must wrap intentionally rather than colliding, clipping, or overflowing.
Keep desktop and tablet Portfolio layouts stable so the repair does not introduce a regression on larger viewports.
state_constraints: desktop_portfolio and tablet_portfolio show the Project Path Selector segments on a single comfortable row with the selected-project panel and project cards below; no horizontal overflow.

mobile_portfolio (390px) is the state under repair: with the defect the selector row is a fixed-width non-wrapping line that overflows the viewport; the reference reflows the segments so there is no horizontal overflow.
desktop_portfolio_filtered captures the interaction: after clicking the Build stage segment, the selected-project panel and the visible project cards reflect the Build-stage filter.
desktop_home, mobile_home, and tablet_home capture the unchanged portfolio home hero and navigation and must have no horizontal overflow on any leg.

change_completion: The Project Path Selector renders all five stage segments and remains interactive on the Portfolio route.
Selecting a stage still updates the selected-project panel and the filtered project cards.
design_consistency: The repaired selector keeps the teal-accented chip styling, count badges, and Tailwind spacing rhythm.
Desktop and tablet Portfolio layouts remain stable after the fix.
regression: Static Vite output still serves without a custom dev server and every route remains reachable.
Home, navigation, project cards, and the selected-project panel are unchanged across legs.
responsive: The 390px mobile Portfolio route has no horizontal overflow after the fix.
The selector segments wrap intentionally on mobile rather than clipping or colliding.

author_notes: Repo-grounded Vite/React/TypeScript portfolio extend_interaction/design_continuity flow task. The interactive Project Path Selector strip is the extended interaction; the product-grade discriminator is a deterministic no_horizontal_overflow gate on the mobile_portfolio state (tolerance 24px): reference reflows the strip to 0 overflow, the original-with-defect baseline and a shallow overflow-x:hidden non-fix both keep the mobile Portfolio page overflowing. Content and DOM are byte-identical across all three legs; the only leg-varying file is src/components/path-selector.css. Runtime is clean (0 console/network errors) on every state. The task also enforces cross-state dom_assertions and text signals so a solution must keep the selector interactive and the portfolio intact, not merely tweak the mobile width.
